findings.detail: Git push attempt followed by fallback to merge via fake PR - if merge fails after push attempt, state may be inconsistent
findings.recommendation: The fake PR merge approach is a workaround; consider proper merge-upstream git operation

findings.detail: Git operations use context cancellation but no explicit timeout on the merge operation
findings.recommendation: Ensure request context has appropriate deadline for long-running git operations

non_atomic_operations: Git push attempt + fallback merge via fake PR if push fails
endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: Git operations on disk could block if filesystem is slow

findings.detail: Each test creates a new hook_task - safe to retry but will create duplicate deliveries
If webhooks are disabled globally (setting.DisableWebhooks), PrepareWebhook silently returns nil
findings.recommendation: Could return a more informative response to the user

endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: none - delivery is async via queue
endpoint_resiliency.graceful_degradation: Webhook delivery failures don't affect the API response

rate_limiting.detail: No per-endpoint rate limiting for webhook APIs
rate_limiting.recommendation: Consider rate limiting webhook test endpoint to prevent abuse

dead_letter_queues.detail: Failed webhook deliveries are tracked in hook_task with status
